messages.subject: Re: MSStats with DIA-NN. DIANNtoMSstatsFormat input file.
messages.subject_clean: MSStats with DIA-NN. DIANNtoMSstatsFormat input file.
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

You need the DIA-NN PSM report. It should be named "diann_report.tsv". Additionally, you will need to create an annotation file that maps the run names in DIA-NN to your experimental design. For more information on this check out the MSstats v4 paper supplementary <https://pubs.acs.org/doi/suppl/10.1021/acs.jproteome.2c00834/suppl_file/pr2c00834_si_001.pdf>.

Best,
Devon

messages.body_plain:
Hi Lara,

Ok that makes sense. Did you generate the `msstats.csv` file from FragPipe? It's actually really easy to use MSstatsPTM with FragPipe via the converter. I've included some code below to get the workflow started. From there you can just use the code you sent over.

One note is that without a global profiling run we generally do not recommend normalizing for changes in the underlying protein level. We can extract unmodified peptides from the enriched run and use them in place of the global profiling run, however this usually does not work as well.

```
fragpipe_input = read.csv("msstats.csv")

msstats_data = FragPipetoMSstatsPTMFormat(fragpipe_input,
                                          label_type="LF",
                                          mod_id_col = "STY", # Just add in the name of the modification column in the msstats.csv file
                                          use_unmod_peptides=FALSE # Set this to TRUE if you want to extract unmod peptides for normalization
)
```

Devon

messages.body_plain:
Dear all，
In the label-free quantification workflow, I understand that the msstats_format_lf file contains lists of both modified peptides and proteins. These protein lists seem to be derived directly from the results of the current experiment(evidence file). If I were to conduct a separate protein quantification experiment, could I generate a protein list using MSstats or MSstatsTMT? And subsequently, could I replace the protein list generated by MSstatsPTM with this newly generated protein list, enabling me to proceed with the downstream analysis? Does anyone have any good methods and code to share?

Best,
Gaoxiang
